title: Fix Off-By-One in Binary Range Partitioner
instruction: Fix the binary range partitioning function in partitioner.py. The upper bound slice calculation includes an extra element causing index out of range when end == len(array). Run pytest to verify.
test_code:
import pytest
from partitioner import partition_range

def test_partition_even():
    arr = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
    left, right = partition_range(arr, 0, 5)
    assert left == [0, 1] and right == [2, 3, 4, 5]

def test_partition_boundary():
    arr = [10, 20, 30]
    left, right = partition_range(arr, 0, 2)
    assert len(left) + len(right) == 3
    assert right[-1] == 30
